replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Evidence shows URL fetch from inside VPC next to metadata service; classic concrete SSRF attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack vector (non-HTTP schemes, local file read) on the same unrestricted URL parameter."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design states only a URL parameter with no auth; unauthenticated internal abuse of privileged fetcher is concrete."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design includes decoding/resizing attacker-chosen images; resource exhaustion attack is concrete and distinct."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Redirect/DNS rebinding bypass is a distinct mechanism against the described fetcher behaviour."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Write/action-triggering confused deputy differs from T1's read-only disclosure; supported by VPC position evidence."}]}
